name: Image / Likeness Cloning
objectives: Reproduce a subject's likeness or visual style from reference images only after a verified consent record exists
Generate new images conditioned on the reference identity or style
Watermark every generated image for provenance
tasks: Validate a signed consent record against the reference image hash before any generation run
Refuse a subject who is not confirmed to be an adult
Refuse a sexual, violent, or defamatory prompt
Run local generation only when the packages and weights are installed on the user's machine
benchmarks: A watermark bit is present on the saved image
safety_constraints: Never clone a likeness without a verified consent record tied to the exact reference image
Never process reference images of a minor
Reject requests for sexual, violent, or defamatory depictions of a real person regardless of consent status
